searchText: Trying to fix neth-prysm pair, prysm says "Could not compute head from new attestations", What can it be? Nimbus pairs reach the head from time to time, mostly after reboot cc: <@363800010518822915> sounds like a different issue than we're seeing with geth/erigon can't peer with the lighthouse nodes it seems or lighthouse nodes rate limiting... I think lh has a disable peer scoring flag now? Might be useful to add it for early testnets yeah nimbus stayed in sync for most of yesterday, but since today has fallen behind, not sure why, 👀 <@131476523050860545> can we add the disable peer scoring flag mentioned by <@199561711278227457> to our lighthouse nodes? sounds good. gonna check which flag that is. Does someone know in here? lodestar log shows its dialing to lighthouse peers, but its not succeeding If it's a peer scoring issue, it would be nice to know why they're having a low score / being disconnected. The lighthouse nodes are not even close to the max peers that they could have (80). checking it out Yeah agree <@131476523050860545> just thought enabling it might confirm that peer scoring is the issue. It looks like we are rate limiting I'll try to figure out why and see if we can add some config to loosen it <@131476523050860545> this PR: https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/pull/4135 --disable-peer-scoring Nice. Thanks. I was looking around using `lighthouse bn --help` but couldn't find that flag there. <@607055410104500244> would that improve the rate limiting if I set that flag? Or do you prefer to keep the nodes running as they are to debug the issue. I think I've pinned it down, we rate limit as a function of `MAX_REQUEST_BLOCKS`, which was decreased for deneb but we haven't adjusted our limiting for the new value so it's good with me if you add the flag, although I'm not sure it also will disable disconnects from rate limiting. We have another more specific config, let me try to find it Ah the config I was thinking of is just for outbound requests and this is inbound Ok. Shall I try the `--disable-peer-scoring` flag, or wait for a fix? I just pushed a fix to https://github.com/realbigsean/lighthouse/tree/devnetv5 Can you run that and also add `--self-limiter 'blob_sidecars_by_range:512/10'` Just triggered an image build for that. I'll update the nodes once it's ready. PR for the explicit requirement here: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/7014 done. all lighthouse nodes have been updated with the new version and that flag. <@206016661470314496> or anyone from geth actually, how did you deal with Go_KZG strong typing in supporting it? did you convert your internal types to theirs or are you casting?
